name: Average Teaching Dimension / Minimum Teaching-Set Size
details: The arithmetic mean of the individual minimum teaching-set sizes is at least their minimum.
proof: Every individual minimum teaching-set size is at least $\mathrm{TS}_{\mathrm{min}}$. Averaging over all concepts gives $\mathrm{TS}_{\mathrm{avg}}\ge\mathrm{TS}_{\mathrm{min}}$.
